build_restapi_tokenize: build a python module to run a fastapi server with /tokenize and /detokenize endpoints for tokenizing and detokenizing text
create_endpoint_tokenize: create a POST endpoint that tokenizes input text and returns token IDs using the vLLM tokenizer
create_endpoint_detokenize: create a POST endpoint that detokenizes token IDs back into text using the vLLM tokenizer
create_endpoint_tokenizer_info: create a GET endpoint that returns comprehensive tokenizer information from the vLLM model
run_attach_router: run attach_router to conditionally register the tokenizer info endpoint and attach the router to a FastAPI app
